model: Same native isothermal 696-state COMSOL baseline; no physical evolution in Python
preparation: Cumulative SET blocks of eight pulses, initial READ per block and READ after each pulse; all four histories have the identical operation prefix. RESET probes never feed back into preparation.
stability: For each screened level: baseline READ, hold 1 tau then READ, hold 10 tau then READ, 8 consecutive READs, and 0.98 tau zero-bias then READ. Short envelope includes all except hold10; extended includes all. Include original programming verification G in both envelopes. At least two separated levels must each satisfy the joint 1% envelope across all histories and operations.
selection: Ascending SET count, then wait 1 before wait 10. Screen all 17 pulse counts. Validate a maximally separated up-to-four-level set first; if fewer than two remain stable, test further screening-passing counts. Stop at first protocol with at least two jointly stable separated levels; report up to four, preferring the extended window when the same number passes. Wait0 is diagnostic only.
limits: No claims outside tested histories/windows; no transistor or array circuit in this run. Tau, absolute G and I remain uncalibrated.
original_histories: Native reference at prior polarity_positive.csv row 0
Prior history_high.csv final state: four SET pulses with verify reads
Prior history_low.csv final state: four RESET pulses with verify reads
Prior history_aged.csv final state: four SET pulses, 100 tau hold and read
conditional_reset_extension: If the original campaign finds no accepted protocol, extend one stationary fixed-wait candidate to RESET count 32. Select the candidate with the widest observed G span among its 1%-history-passing counts; ties prefer fewer SET pulses and shorter wait. Continue each native count-16 state with an extra checkpoint READ then 16 further fixed RESET pulses with verification. All original gates remain unchanged. Validate the resulting candidate levels and repeat a refined native reference before acceptance.

adaptive_followup.reason: Original maximum-span extension used SET128/wait1, whose tested levels all failed the 1% operating-window gate. Independently test extension of SET32/wait10, where RESET12-16 already passed short-window stability but lacked 10% separation. Bounded to one additional protocol, same pulses and gates. This was selected after inspecting earlier results, not predeclared.

numerical_boundary_followup: Adaptive sensitivity check at rtol=1e-9 for histories0/3 producing RESET19/20 envelope extrema, after observing 0.998% versus 1.049% short envelopes. Repeat last SET block, wait, full extended RESET probe and READ8 branches. Other histories and hold branches not repeated.
